concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-008 (significance declaration based on p‑value < 0.05 and ΔMAE ≥ 0.1 log‑TOF) is marked as ✅ in the FR coverage table but is not referenced in the Phase Mapping table; no concrete task or script is assigned to implement or verify this requirement.

The plan includes a “Constitution Check” table that records compliance with the project constitution, but the specification does not request such a table. This is an over‑reach; consider linking it to a relevant FR/SC (e.g., SC‑004) or removing it.
